item.text: {"rule":"The observations are insufficient to identify a deterministic rule. In 9 of 10 rounds, the cat petted at the second step became the final cat, but in Round 1 it left instead. Likewise, the first petted pair sometimes stayed and sometimes left, even for the same pair, suggesting a round-dependent or random procedure."}
